card.name: Partway through medical terms and doses
card.fires_on: The middle of a split medical word (proph-yl-axis, cerebro-vascular, antithrom-bot-ic) or the last zero in a heparin-style number like 5,000 units. Also fires on 'recurrence' after 'distant'.

modes.label: Inside split medical words
modes.description: Middle piece of a long clinical term such as prophylaxis, cerebrovascular or antithrombotic.

modes.label: Digit in 5,000 units
modes.description: The final zero in a heparin dose written as 5,000 units.

modes.label: Relapse and recurrence words
modes.description: Words about disease coming back or long-term effect after a qualifier.
